mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id" ,NICKNAME AS "nickname" FROM T_USER WHERE 1=1 AND NICKNAME = #{nickname} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL LIMIT 2

SELECT C.ID AS "id" ,TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate" ,ME.NICKNAME AS "myName" ,P.NICKNAME AS "partnerName" FROM T_COUPLE C JOIN T_USER ME ON ME.ID = #{userId} JOIN T_USER P ON P.ID = CASE WHEN C.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN C.PARTNER_ID ELSE C.REQUESTER_ID END WHERE 1=1 AND C.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (C.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR C.PARTNER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY C.ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT C.ID AS "id" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM C.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" FROM T_COUPLE C JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = C.PARTNER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND C.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND C.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY C.ID DESC

SELECT C.ID AS "id" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM C.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" FROM T_COUPLE C JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = C.REQUESTER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND C.PARTNER_ID = #{userId} AND C.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY C.ID DESC
SELECT ID AS "id" ,REQUESTER_ID AS "requesterId" ,PARTNER_ID AS "partnerId" ,STATUS AS "status" FROM T_COUPLE WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_COUPLE WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR PARTNER_ID = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_COUPLE WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND ((REQUESTER_ID = #{a} AND PARTNER_ID = #{b}) OR (REQUESTER_ID = #{b} AND PARTNER_ID = #{a}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_COUPLE WHERE 1=1 AND REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_COUPLE (REQUESTER_ID, PARTNER_ID, START_DATE) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{partnerId}, #{startDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE T_COUPLE C SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ,ACCEPTED_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND C.ID = #{id} AND C.PARTNER_ID = #{partnerId} AND C.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_COUPLE X WHERE X.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (X.REQUESTER_ID IN (C.REQUESTER_ID, C.PARTNER_ID) OR X.PARTNER_ID IN (C.REQUESTER_ID, C.PARTNER_ID)) )
UPDATE T_COUPLE SET STATUS = 'DECLINED' ,ENDED_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id} AND PARTNER_ID = #{partnerId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE T_COUPLE SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' ,ENDED_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id} AND REQUESTER_ID = #{requesterId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE T_COUPLE SET STATUS = 'ENDED' ,ENDED_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR PARTNER_ID = #{userId})
UPDATE T_COUPLE SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' ,ENDED_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND (REQUESTER_ID IN (#{a}, #{b}) OR PARTNER_ID IN (#{a}, #{b}))
